scope: Read-only verification of installation-font admission lifetime; no product changes
findings: prewarmVisionSession serializes with scene loads and returns when the same live session already has fontsReady
mountVisionSceneNow enumerates installationFonts only while session.fontsReady is false; the flag is set after successful admissions
The existing prepares-empty-engine test verifies one catalogue invocation across two prewarms and subsequent scene load, using one presenter
InstallationFontBatches itself fetches and hashes on each explicit invocation; this low-level repeated invocation is not the persistent-session scene path
The prior forced second-transfer benchmark does not establish repeated production scene-load cost
limitations: Synthetic presenter tests do not qualify current installed common Prism or TTC face and glyph coverage
No new memory cache, scene history, integrity bypass, runtime installation or shared-app restart
